name: org.machanism.machai:project-layout
description: Project Layout is a Java 8 library for build tools, repository scanners, generators, validators, documentation tools, and indexers that need a consistent representation of a project's directory structure. org.machanism.machai.project.ProjectLayoutManager detects Maven, Gradle, JavaScript or TypeScript, Python, and generic filesystem layouts in that order and configures the selected org.machanism.machai.project.layout.ProjectLayout with the project root. The common layout abstraction exposes root-relative production-source, test, and documentation paths, optional module paths, exclusion-aware directory traversal, and relative-path utilities. MavenProjectLayout parses pom.xml metadata and modules, GradleProjectLayout uses the Gradle Tooling API for child projects, JScriptProjectLayout expands array-form package.json workspaces, PythonProjectLayout recognizes public named pyproject.toml projects, and DefaultProjectLayout is a filesystem fallback. ProjectProcessor recursively visits detected modules and provides a leaf-project processing hook.

constructors.description: Creates a Maven-specific layout. Set its project root before reading Maven modules or conventional and configured Maven source, test, resource, and documentation paths.

examples.description: Configure a Maven project root, then obtain source roots for scanning or generation.

constructors.description: Creates a Maven POM reader that parses pom.xml files into org.apache.maven.model.Model instances for Maven layout metadata discovery.

examples.snippet:
org.machanism.machai.project.layout.PomReader reader = new org.machanism.machai.project.layout.PomReader();
org.apache.maven.model.Model model = reader.getProjectModel(new java.io.File("./pom.xml"));
examples.description: Read a Maven model directly when a tool also needs Maven metadata.

features.name: detectProjectLayout
features.signature: public static org.machanism.machai.project.layout.ProjectLayout detectProjectLayout(java.io.File projectDir) throws java.io.FileNotFoundException
features.description: Detects a supported project descriptor and returns a configured layout. Detection precedence is Maven, Gradle, JavaScript or TypeScript, Python, then DefaultProjectLayout for an existing directory without a supported descriptor.

examples.description: Automatically select a layout before analyzing a repository whose build ecosystem is not known in advance.

features.name: getSources
features.description: Returns production source roots as paths relative to the configured project directory. Concrete layouts supply convention-based or metadata-derived values.

examples.description: Resolve every root against getProjectDir() before accessing it on the filesystem.

features.name: scanFolder
features.signature: public void scanFolder(java.io.File projectDir) throws java.io.IOException
features.description: Detects the layout of a directory and recursively scans non-null module lists. When a layout has no modules, the processor invokes the subclass processFolder hook for that leaf project.

examples.description: Run a consumer-defined processor over a repository and its detected modules.

features.name: getRelativePath
features.signature: public static java.lang.String getRelativePath(java.io.File dir, java.io.File file, boolean addSingleDot)
features.description: Calculates a path from a project directory to a target file. It can add a leading ./ when requested and returns null when the target is outside the project directory.

examples.description: Convert an in-project filesystem location to a portable root-relative path.

studs.name: org.machanism.machai.project.layout.ProjectLayout
studs.description: Configured common abstraction for project modules; root-relative production, test, and documentation roots; path conversion; and exclusion-aware file and directory traversal.

examples.description: Program against the shared abstraction so a tool can work across supported ecosystems.

studs.name: org.machanism.machai.project.ProjectProcessor
studs.description: Recursive repository traversal base class. Subclasses implement processFolder to handle each detected leaf layout while the base class handles layout detection and module recursion.

examples.description: Provide leaf-project behavior and let ProjectProcessor recurse through modules.

examples.name: Install, configure, and run a Maven consumer
steps: Build and install Project Layout locally from its project root with mvn clean install.
Add the dependency XML in dependencyConfiguration to the consuming Maven application's pom.xml.
Create a consumer entry point that calls org.machanism.machai.project.ProjectLayoutManager.detectProjectLayout for the repository path supplied at runtime.
Package the consumer and run it against a repository to print the resolved source-root directories.
examples.description: This complete scenario installs the library, configures a Maven consumer, and invokes that consumer for a real target repository.

examples.name: Process a multi-module repository
steps: Implement processFolder to analyze each leaf layout's source roots.
Instantiate the processor and call scanFolder with the repository root.
ProjectProcessor detects layouts and recursively follows each reported module.
examples.description: Use recursive module processing for source indexing, generation, or validation across a multi-module repository.
